ITEM 1 | Pale yellow squash wedges/slices with bright yellow skin, a few pieces roughly 4-5 cm long, smooth glossy skin, slightly soft-looking flesh, sitting at upper center of plate | 60
ITEM 2 | Dark green rounded slices with darker green rind edges, thin pieces about 4 cm across, matte skin, lying among the squash and greens near the top | 25
ITEM 3 | Crisp-looking light green leafy lettuce pieces, torn into irregular shards about 3-6 cm, lightly coated with a creamy pale dressing, sitting in the left-center of the plate | 70
ITEM 4 | Creamy pale dressing coating the lettuce, glossy and light, visible as sheen and thin film over the leaves | 10
ITEM 5 | Grated or shaved pale yellow-white cheese flakes scattered over the lettuce, small irregular shreds about 0.5-1 cm, dry and slightly crumbly | 8
ITEM 6 | Golden-brown toasted bread croutons, cubes about 1.5-2 cm with browned, slightly crisp surfaces, scattered across the lettuce and along the left edge | 20
ITEM 7 | Grilled meat slices with brown seared exterior and grill marks, pinkish-tan interior, sliced into strips about 1 cm thick and 6-8 cm long, arranged on the right side of the plate, slightly juicy looking | 90
ITEM 8 | Small pale-green herb or leafy pieces mixed among the meat and squash, dark green with ragged edges, about 2 cm across, scattered near the middle right | 8
